english.title: Possess air weapon and fail to take reasonable precautions to prevent under 18 years of age having it with them
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having possession of an air weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF AIR WEAPON..) to fail to take reasonable precautions to prevent a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was under the age of eighteen from having the weapon with them
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24ZA of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Section 24ZA(3) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968 provides that in proceedings for this offence it is a defence to show that the person charged with the offence-
(a) believed the other person to be aged eighteen or over; and (b) had reasonable ground for that belief.
(ii) Section 24ZA(4) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968 provides that for the purposes of this section a person shall be taken to have shown the matters specified in section 24za(3) if -
(a) sufficient evidence of those matters is adduced to raise an issue with respect to them; and (b) the contrary is not proved beyond a reasonable doubt."
(iii) This offence was inserted by section 46 of the Crime and Security Act 2010.
